senses.gloss: ch.<cite ref="N00459">same</cite> <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 91:7">Targ. Ps. XCI, 7</cite> <he>יקרבון למִנְזָק</he> (h. text <he>יגש</he>); a. e.

units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 12:14">Targ. Jer. XII, 14</cite> (h. text <he>נגע</he>); a. e.
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 11:7">Targ. Ex. XI, 7</cite> <he>לא יַנְזֵק … בלישניה</he> ed. Berl. (ed. Vien. <he>לישניה</he>, corr. acc.; Y. <he>יְהַנְ׳</he>); a. e.—
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 27b">B. Kam. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>הוא דא׳ אנפשיה</he> it is he who hurt himself (through his own action); <cite ref="Bava Kamma 28a">ib. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ נפשיה</he>.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 13b:21">Ib. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>אַזְּקֵיה תורא דמשאיל וכ׳</he> the ox of the lender injured that of the borrower.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 13b:21">Ib.</cite> <he>אזקי</he> ed. (read with Ms. M. <he>אזקיה</he>).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 117a:6">B. Mets. 117ᵃ</cite> <he>אזלי ומַזְּקֵי וכ׳</he> the water came down and damaged the property of those living below; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Gittin 53a:14">Gitt. 53ᵃ</cite> <he>לאוזוקי קא מכוין</he> (read: <he>לאַזּוּקֵיה</he> or <he>לאַנְזוּקֵיה</he>, Rashi <he>לצעריה</he>) he has the intention to harm him.

senses.gloss: , Ittaf. אִיתַּזַּק; Ithpe. אִיתְנְזִיק, אִינְּזִיק to be hurt, to meet with an accident.
units: <cite ref="Targum of II Chronicles 32:31">Targ. II Chr. XXXII, 31</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 5:24">Targ. Job V, 24</cite>.—
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 13b:21">B. Kam. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>אילו איתזק מעלמא</he> if he had been hurt through any other cause.
<cite ref="Berakhot 9b:17">Ber. 9ᵇ</cite> <he>ואִיתַּזְּקִי</he> and I met with evil; <he>במאי אִיתַּזְּקַת</he> what was the evil thou didst meet with?—
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 24:3">Lev. R. s. 24</cite> <he>ולית אתון מִתְנַזְּקִין</he> and you have never been injured.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 29b:12">Kidd. 29ᵇ</cite> <he>הוו מִיתַּזְּקֵי</he> they used to be hurt (by a demon, v. <cite ref="M00757"><he>מַזִּיק</he></cite>); a. fr.
